import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

# Read input values
data = input().split()
N, M, P = map(int, data)

MAXN = 510
comb = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]
f1_dp = [0] * (MAXN)
g1_dp = [0] * (MAXN)
f2_dp = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]
g2_dp = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]

# Precompute combinations
for i in range(N + 1):
    comb[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        comb[i][j] = (comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j]) % P

# Initialize f1_dp and g1_dp
f1_dp[0] = 1
for i in range(1, N + 1):
    f1_dp[i] = 0
    g1_dp[i] = 0
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        f1_dp[i] = (f1_dp[i] + f1_dp[j - 1] * f1_dp[i - j] % P * comb[i - 1][j - 1]) % P
        t = ((f1_dp[j - 1] * g1_dp[i - j] + g1_dp[j - 1] * f1_dp[i - j]) % P)
        t = (t * (i + 1)) % P
        g1_dp[i] = (g1_dp[i] + (f1_dp[j - 1] * f1_dp[i - j] % P * (comb[j][2] + comb[i - j + 1][2]) + t) % P * comb[i - 1][j - 1]) % P
    f1_dp[i] = ((i + 1) * f1_dp[i]) % P

# Initialize g2_dp and f2_dp
g2_dp[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, N + 1):
    for j in range(0, min(i, M) + 1):
        f2_dp[i][j] = f2_dp[i - 1][j]
        g2_dp[i][j] = g2_dp[i - 1][j]
        for k in range(1, j + 1):
            f_val = f2_dp[i - k - 1][j - k] if i - k else 1
            f2_dp[i][j] = (f2_dp[i][j] + f_val * f1_dp[k] % P * comb[j][k]) % P
            g_val = f2_dp[i - k - 1][j - k] if i - k else 1
            g_part = (g_val * g1_dp[k] + (g2_dp[i - k - 1][j - k] if i - k else 0) * f1_dp[k]) % P
            g2_dp[i][j] = (g2_dp[i][j] + g_part * comb[j][k]) % P

# Output the result
print(g2_dp[N][M])
